parts.note_add: Genuine Mazda coils are no longer made; Atkins sells an aftermarket NGK coil under 8245-18-100 for all 1980-85 12A/13B. S-001 Section B: trailing coil B-18 (BW +, YG -), leading coil B-19 (BW +, YL -); confirm on the car.

Leading timing is set by rotating the housing on its lock nut, trailing timing by moving the trailing vacuum unit on its screws (S-002 p.5-36, S-006 p.44). Atkins lists a rebuilt 1981-85 unit as N249-18-200A (NLA).
Atkins sells 8245-24-310B for all 1980-85 rotaries at 57.00 USD; Mazdatrix lists it as 24-310B-8245 at 58.32 USD.
Standard Motor Products JR87 crosses to 8245-24-303A (RockAuto).
The 16,000 ohm +/-40% lead limit is per 1 m (39.37 in) of lead (S-002 p.5-37). On 1981 cars the leading leads had black boots and the trailing leads blue (S-006 p.44); confirm on the car.
NGK stock number for BR8EQ-14 is 2329.

N236-24-314 is sold as pick-up coil and breaker plate for all 1981-85 RX-7 (Atkins 330.00 USD, out of stock; Mazdatrix 253.86 USD). Each pick-up coil's two leads run straight into its igniter (S-001 Section B).
The air gap is measured between the signal rotor's protrusion and the pick-up coil core (S-002 p.5-35).

Aftermarket replacement Standard Motor Products LX-642 (obsolete) crosses to E30124910; Mazdatrix sells used, tested igniters at 135.00 USD. Trailing igniter B-20 (YG, BW), leading B-21 (YL, BW) per S-001; confirm on the car.
The trailing vacuum unit's position on its attaching screws sets trailing timing (S-002 p.5-36; S-006 p.44).
Capacity 0.24-0.30 uF (S-038 T:3). Single BW lead (B-22) to the ignition feed, case to ground (S-001 Section B); confirm on the car.

specs.item: Ignition timing mark colours and pointer
specs.value: Leading mark yellow, trailing mark red on the eccentric shaft pulley; read against the indicator pin on the front cover
specs.note: Colours from the 1981 training manual, indicator pin from the 1985 workshop manual; no 1982 source opened states them. Confirm on the car.

specs.value: Leading: loosen the distributor lock nut and rotate the housing. Trailing: loosen the trailing vacuum unit's attaching screws and move the unit
specs.note: 1985 and 1981 manuals give the same method; no 1982 source opened states it.

specs.value: Set leading yellow mark on the pulley to the indicator pin; align tally marks on housing and driven gear; turn the housing until the signal rotor protrusion aligns with the pick-up core; tighten lock nut
DC ammeter (max graduation 1 mA) across the coupler terminals; the needle must move when a screwdriver on the magnet core is quickly pulled away; test leading and trailing
specs.note: 1985 procedure; resistance values are on the distributor (PT014).

specs.value: If the gap between the signal rotor protrusion and pick-up core is out of spec, replace the pick-up coil and bearing assembly or the distributor drive shaft
specs.note: The 0.5-0.9 mm figure is already recorded on PT014 from S-038.

specs.value: Bench circuit with a 12 V test lamp of less than 10 W; switching ON and OFF quickly must make the lamp flash; test each igniter
